explication: This repository repackages Anthropic’s official Linux Claude Desktop for additional Linux distributions and adds a launcher, diagnostics, Linux-specific patches, and an optional Cowork fallback. The principal workflow is official Debian package → project packaging and Linux adaptations → installable formats → launch and use on a Linux desktop. The README documents these capabilities, but the sampled source is chiefly test-harness code; edges below therefore cite documented relationships rather than claiming those runtime implementations were inspected.
